questions.question: What metaphor does Paul use to describe Gentile believers being included with Israel?
options: A new stone added to the building of God's house
A fresh young vine planted beside an older and fruitful vine
A field of wheat sown among the standing grain
A wild olive branch grafted into a cultivated olive tree
questions.answer: A wild olive branch grafted into a cultivated olive tree
